message:
Have you ever been caught off guard by a sudden blackout? I know I have! A little preparation can turn a potential hassle into a small win that saves the day. I found this great resource that walks you through simple steps to get ready for power outages—it's packed with practical tips that can really make a difference. I’ve started keeping some flashlights and non-perishable snacks handy, just in case! 

What’s your go-to tip for handling a blackout? I'd love to hear your clever tricks! 😊
